correctness.rationale: For W_{n,q}=K_1 join (n disjoint K_q), n>=2,q>=3, deletion of center is the join of the cardinality-at-most-r blade skeletons; center link is the cardinality-at-most-(r-1) simplex skeleton. The mapping cone is A union(c*L); for r<q the join A is (nr-2)-connected, so the (r-2)-dimensional inclusion L->A is null, yielding exactly binomial(nq-1,r-1) spheres S^{r-1} and binomial(q-1,r)^n spheres S^{nr-1}; for r>=q A is contractible. Integral augmented exterior chains give wedge^{r-1} V_{nq}, and join Kunneth gives tensor_i wedge^r V_q with Koszul block-exchange sign (-1)^r. The S_q^n invariants vanish on each positive-degree exterior blade term, and the remaining block-label exterior power has no S_n invariant for r-1>=1, so the ordinary quotient is rationally acyclic.
